answer: Cross-epoch work trellis. Each identity must publish a trajectory of task outputs whose internal structure forms a linked lattice: every new epoch's work must reference and extend prior outputs, and peers verify the links against an archived crystal of past commitments. An attacker must synthesize a coherent, growing history per sock puppet rather than one-off actions, so cost scales with history depth times identity count. Spawning a fresh meadow of identities each epoch yields unverifiable roots, which validators reject.
